note: Campground with a bar and grill on Tri Lakes Road at Amnicon Lake, south of Superior. The sites climb the hill north of the road; the swim beach and boat slips are across the road by the bar. Most of the 97 RV sites are not sold online, and a small mobile home park adjoins. The operator warns that GPS routing uses back gravel roads not suited to towing: from the south, follow WI 35 to County B, County A south, then Tri Lakes Road. --Claude
summary: Operator site + ParkWith.us engine read: $45 a night on every online RV site (June/Aug 2027; was $40 from old note), 30/50A full hookups, 97 RV sites 22-65 ft, season May 1-Oct 15; only 7 RV + 3 tent sites sold online (~10%) - long-stay flag. Lakeview -> not waterfront lead (sites 145 m+ back across road, bar and houses). Pin ~340 m off (at the bar). Google 4.6 (158).
flags: PRICE GATE: passes - $45 a night (ParkWith.us quote for a 23-ft rig, June 8 and August 13 2027) plus an 8% engine service fee and 5.5% tax. Presence: operator website + phone + booking engine; Google 4.6 (158; the listing covers the bar and restaurant too). RV Life 5*/$$ stored.

LONG-STAY (reviewer, borderline test 4): the engine lists 97 RV sites but offers only 7 online (50, 62, 64, 73, 84, 85, 94) plus Tents 1-3; with 4 tent sites that is 10 of ~101 (~10%), right at the 1-in-10 line. Nothing says the other 90 are seasonal - they may sell by phone - and the operator's wording never discourages nightly guests (it sells same-day, 1-night stays; over 21 nights 'please call'). The rules read residential in places ('The site and camper must be well maintained ... Violators will be given a notice to clean up their site or repair camper'). The campground map labels a 'Mobile home Park' (5 homes) at the north edge; homes don't outnumber RV sites (test 5 passes). October Esri imagery shows ~25 trailers on the ~55-site grid, many pads empty. Test 1 ($45) and 2 (online nightly sale) and 3 (no minimum) pass. Read as at the line: if kept, the note should say most sites are long-term.

WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade lakeview -> not waterfront, not an --AWH value): the campground map puts every site north of Tri Lakes Road; the road, the office/bar and its parking lot, and a row of private houses lie between the sites and Amnicon Lake. The nearest RV sites (41-44, open lawn ~46.4856,-92.0634) are ~145 m from the shore on Esri with the bar building, lot and house lots between; the rest climb the hill 250-500 m back under trees. No site photo shows the lake. 'Lakefront camping' is marketing. Not waterfront.
